playbook.headline: Fewer, sharper plays. The first two days had too many bets, too much overlap and some guessed prices.
rules: 3 to 6 plays a night, never more than 5 units total at risk.
Only bet posted prices. No estimated lines, ever.
Minimum 3 points of edge (my win % minus the book’s implied %).
Props first. Sides and totals are the sharpest markets; our side bets went 0–3 as singles. A side needs a stale-line or late-injury reason to make the card.
Flat staking: 1u on standard plays, 0.5u on plus-money or thinner edges. No 1.5u bets.
One player, one ticket. No player appears in more than one bet on the same night.
One parlay a night at most, built only from that night’s singles. Flyers capped at 0.25u total per day.
Bounce-back only counts if minutes and shot attempts held steady. Injury usage only counts if the news broke after the line was set.
Log the closing price on every play. Beating the close is the real test of skill; judge the model after 100+ plays, not after two days.
Weekly stop: if a week hits −10u, drop to half units until we’re back to even.
